resources.string: Record location while other apps are on the car screen
On. Trip distance, time, average speed and the parking spot stay accurate even while Maps or another app is on the car screen.
Off. While another app is on the car screen, trip statistics pause and the parking spot may be less accurate. Tap to turn on.
Location is not set to “Allow all the time”, so recording stops while another app is on the car screen. Tap to fix.

To keep trip distance, time and average speed and to save where you parked even while another app (such as Maps) is on the car screen, FermataX collects your location in the background, only during Android Auto sessions. The location never leaves your phone. You can turn this off at any time in Settings.\n\nOn the next screen choose “Allow all the time”.
Location permission “Allow all the time” was not granted
Turn on trip recording in Settings on the phone
Allow location “All the time” on the phone to record trips
